notes: Test questions T01-T11 from runs/rehearsal-research.md section 7, worded exactly as asked, so mark_run.py can match them by text.

Definitions reuse specs/piece-1-truth.json where they match: T01-T03 = Q12, T04 = Q11, T05-T07 = Q13b, T08 = Q13, T09 = Q01, T10 = Q02, T11 = Q08. Values are computed here from the raw CSVs, never copied.

T09's scope is deliberately unstated in the question. It is given the plainest reading, every order row. What Dot does with an unstated scope is part of what this piece tests; mark_run.py compares an answer that states delivered or canceled under T10 or T11.
